commentary.text: 90+6' The match has just finished.
90+6' The ball is out of play. Lazio win a corner kick.
90+5' Lazio have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
90+5' Cristian Volpato (Sassuolo) is booked by the referee.
90+4' Cristian Volpato (Sassuolo) is penalised for holding. Paride Tremolada signals a set piece. Lazio are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
90+1' The referee signals a corner kick to Lazio.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
90' Lazio win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
90' The referee gives a yellow card to Nemanja Matic (Sassuolo).
88' Paride Tremolada interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Nuno Tavares (Lazio).
85' Reda Belahyane (Lazio) picked up a yellow card from referee.
81' Andrea Pinamonti goes off the pitch and Walid Cheddira (Sassuolo) comes on.
81' Substitution. Domenico Berardi makes his way off the pitch and Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo) comes on as his replacement.
80' Here is a change. Matteo Guendouzi is going off and Maurizio Sarri gives the last tactical orders to Gustav Isaksen (Lazio).
79' It's a throw-in after the ball crosses the sideline.
77' The referee is firm and issues Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) a deserved yellow card.
75' Lazio will take a corner kick.
75' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
72' The ball falls kindly for Pedro (Lazio) inside the box, but it's a poor effort and flies high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Sassuolo will have a goal kick.
70' 1 - 0 Goal! Alieu Fadera (Sassuolo) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the bottom left corner. He makes it 1:0.
69' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Sassuolo.
67' Alieu Fadera (Sassuolo) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Paride Tremolada blows his whistle for an infringement.
66' Some great controlled play and passing from Sassuolo. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
65' Good work from Sassuolo as they win a corner.
64' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Armand Lauriente walks off the pitch to be replaced by Alieu Fadera (Sassuolo).
63' Fabio Grosso prepares a substitution. Aster Vranckx is replaced by Cristian Volpato (Sassuolo).
62' Lazio will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
61' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) misses a great chance after he found some space in the box! His glancing header goes over the crossbar.
60' Maurizio Sarri has decided to make a change. Pedro (Lazio) replaces Matteo Cancellieri.
60' Here's the change. Taty Castellanos leaves the pitch and Boulaye Dia (Lazio) comes on as a substitute.
58' Josh Doig (Sassuolo) is given a fully deserved yellow card.
58' Woyo Coulibaly (Sassuolo) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
54' Lazio string together a series of short passes.
51' Sassuolo force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
49' Some neat passing and movement from Lazio as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
46' Maurizio Sarri decides to make a substitution. Fisayo Dele-Bashiru will be replaced by Reda Belahyane (Lazio).
46' Substitution. Woyo Coulibaly (Sassuolo) in, Sebastian Walukiewicz out.
46' Referee Paride Tremolada blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+5' The match has reached half-time.
45+4' Tarik Muharemovic (Sassuolo) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
45' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
42' Adam Marusic (Lazio) is punished with a yellow card for violating the rules.
41' Nicolo Rovella is substituted due to injury. Maurizio Sarri gives a chance to Danilo Cataldi (Lazio).
34' The ball goes out of play. Lazio are awarded a corner kick.
32' Taty Castellanos (Lazio) sends a chip pass into the box, but Arijanet Muric is quickest to intercept the ball.
28' Nicolo Rovella (Lazio) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.

27' Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) runs with the ball towards the keeper and pulls the trigger from close range, but Ivan Provedel anticipates his intention and makes an amazing save to stop the shot going into the bottom right corner.
24' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly changes the colour of the card shown to Aster Vranckx (Sassuolo) to a yellow. Play continues.

23' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Aster Vranckx (Sassuolo), but referee Paride Tremolada must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
23' We have witnessed a sending-off! Aster Vranckx (Sassuolo) is given a red card for his dangerous challenge. Paride Tremolada's decision is final.
22' Paride Tremolada blows his whistle after Matteo Cancellieri (Lazio) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
20' The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Sassuolo.
16' Lazio keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
13' Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
11' Sassuolo are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
9' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) jumps into a tackle and Paride Tremolada signals a foul.
7' Nuno Tavares (Lazio) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
5' Matteo Cancellieri (Lazio) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety.
3' Paride Tremolada blows his whistle and signals a foul after Jay Idzes (Sassuolo) brought his opponent down. Lazio have been awarded a free kick.
2' Some patient build-up play from Lazio as they look to unlock the defence.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
